description: Na₃AlP₃O₉N crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one N and six O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.98 Å. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PNO₃ tetrahedra and  a faceface with one AlO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.36 Å) and three longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PNO₃ tetrahedra and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (1.91 Å) and three longer (1.92 Å) Al-O bond lengths. P is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form PNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent PNO₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-67°. The P-N bond length is 1.72 Å. There is one shorter (1.51 Å) and two longer (1.54 Å) P-O bond lengths. N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and three equivalent P atoms. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom.
